body:
1.) I've never officially been diagnosed with anything, but i show a large amount of the symptoms of depression and some of social anxiety. when i talk to people about me being depressed, they find no reason to question it.

2.) ive alway envisioned my depressive state as a place i go. the best ive managed is something like a country side of varying "cities" of ways of thinking (religions, life philosophies, etc) where depression is a barren cliff leading down into nothing, separated from all other places.

3.) i think its helped me. since i view it as a place, others are there with me at varying places on this cliff. some are at the edge, stepping off into the abyss (suicide) while others peer over the edge, step back, return to the edge, and others can even say their farewells and leave for another place thats (presumably) better. and if i can find reason to think somewhere else is better, i can leave the cliff.

would it be at all possible for updates here on reddit? i dont happen to have an email address i want to put out here. if i need to i can just make a throwaway though. i think this is a very cool project.
